title: PRESENT TENSES PRACTICE & TIPS
description: Master present simple, present continuous, and present perfect tenses.

questions.question: Choose the correct present tense form: 'She _____ to work every day.'
questions.explanation: Present simple is used for habitual actions. Third person singular takes 'goes'.

questions.question: Complete: 'I _____ my homework right now.'
questions.explanation: Present continuous is used for actions happening now. 'Right now' indicates present continuous.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'They _____ in London for five years.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect is used for actions that started in the past and continue to the present. 'For five years' indicates duration.

questions.question: Complete: 'The sun _____ in the east.'
questions.explanation: Present simple is used for general truths and facts. 'The sun rises in the east' is a universal truth.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'Look! It _____ outside.'
questions.explanation: Present continuous is used for actions happening at the moment of speaking. 'Look!' indicates something happening now.

questions.question: Complete: 'I _____ never _____ to Japan.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect with 'never' is used to express life experiences. 'Have never been' is the correct form.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'Water _____ at 100 degrees Celsius.'
questions.explanation: Present simple is used for scientific facts and general truths. 'Water boils at 100°C' is a scientific fact.

questions.question: Complete: 'She _____ her keys. She can't find them anywhere.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect is used for past actions with present consequences. Losing keys affects the present situation.

title: PAST TENSES PRACTICE & TIPS
description: Practice past simple, past continuous, and past perfect tenses.

questions.question: Choose the correct past tense: 'Yesterday, I _____ to the cinema.'
questions.explanation: Past simple is used for completed actions in the past. 'Yesterday' indicates a specific past time.

questions.question: Complete: 'While I _____ dinner, the phone rang.'
questions.explanation: Past continuous is used for actions in progress when another action happened. 'While' indicates simultaneous actions.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'By the time we arrived, the meeting _____ already _____ .'
questions.explanation: Past perfect is used for actions completed before another past action. 'By the time' indicates sequence.

title: Future Tenses Practice
description: Practice using future tenses including will, going to, and present continuous for future.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'I _____ to London next week.'
questions.explanation: Present continuous is used for planned future actions. 'Am going' indicates a definite plan.

questions.question: Complete: 'Look at those clouds! It _____ rain.'
questions.explanation: 'Going to' is used for predictions based on present evidence. The clouds indicate rain is likely.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'I promise I _____ you tomorrow.'
questions.explanation: 'Will' is used for promises, offers, and spontaneous decisions.

questions.question: Complete: 'The train _____ at 3 PM.'
questions.explanation: Present simple is used for scheduled future events like timetables.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'By next year, I _____ my degree.'
questions.explanation: Future perfect is used for actions completed before a specific future time.
